input.command:
cd /home/user/rork-app

# 1. GitHub HEAD SHA
GH_SHA=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('sha',''))" 2>/dev/null)
echo "GITHUB_HEAD_SHA=$GH_SHA"

# 2. Owner auth + Render deploy SHA
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); t=d.get('accessToken',''); open('/tmp/owner_token.txt','w').write(t); print(t)" 2>/dev/null)

RENDER_SHA=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"render_get_deploy_status","input":{}}' 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
r=d.get('result',d)
for entry in r.get('data',[]):
    dep=entry.get('deploy',{})
    if dep.get('status')=='live':
        print(dep.get('commit',{}).get('id',''))
        break
" 2>/dev/null)
echo "RENDER_PRODUCTION_SHA=$RENDER_SHA"

# 3. Runtime SHA
RUNTIME_SHA=$(curl -s "https://api.ivxholding.com/health" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('commit',''))" 2>/dev/null)
echo "RUNTIME_SHA=$RUNTIME_SHA"

# 4. SHA parity
if [ "$GH_SHA" = "$RENDER_SHA" ] && [ "$GH_SHA" = "$RUNTIME_SHA" ] && [ -n "$GH_SHA" ]; then
  echo "SHA_PARITY=YES"
else
  echo "SHA_PARITY=NO"
  echo "  GITHUB=$GH_SHA"
  echo "  RENDER=$RENDER_SHA"
  echo "  RUNTIME=$RUNTIME_SHA"
fi

# 5. File sync
curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/trees/${GH_SHA}?recursive=1" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
files=[t['path'] for t in d.get('tree',[]) if t['type']=='blob']
json.dump(files, open('/tmp/gh_tree.json','w'))
print(f'GITHUB_BLOBS={len(files)}')
print(f'TRUNCATED={d.get(\"truncated\",\"?\")}')
"

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os, json
EX={'node_modules','node_modules-full','.git','.rork','__pycache__','.tmp-frames','.tmp-ivx-frames','dist','home','.github'}
EP=('ivx_20step_','ivx_acceptance_test','phase1_test','cert_test.py','web_qa_')
EF={'.env.example','.gitignore','.gitattributes','.gitmodules','bun.lock','GATE4_RORK_HISTORY_PURGE.md','PROJECT_SEPARATION.md','IVX_CRITICAL_FILES_MANIFEST.json'}
files=[]
for r,ds,fs in os.walk('.'):
    ds[:]=[d for d in ds if d not in EX]
    for f in fs:
        rel=os.path.join(r,f)[2:]
        if any(rel.startswith(p) for p in EP): continue
        if rel in EF: continue
        if rel.endswith(('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.webp','.ico')): continue
        files.append(rel)
files.sort()
ls=set(files); gs=set(json.load(open('/tmp/gh_tree.json')))
m=sorted(ls-gs); p=ls&gs
print(f'TOTAL_EXPECTED={len(ls)}')
print(f'TOTAL_PRESENT={len(p)}')
print(f'MISSING_COUNT={len(m)}')
if m:
    for f in m: print(f'  MISSING: {f}')
else:
    print('MISSING_FILES=NONE')
PYEOF

# 6. Verdict
if [ "$GH_SHA" = "$RENDER_SHA" ] && [ "$GH_SHA" = "$RUNTIME_SHA" ] && [ -n "$GH_SHA" ]; then
  echo "PRODUCTION_SYNCHRONIZED=YES"
  echo "BLOCKER=NONE"
else
  echo "PRODUCTION_SYNCHRONIZED=NO"
  echo "BLOCKER=IDENTIFIED"
fi

TRUNCATED=False
TOTAL_EXPECTED=2010

PRODUCTION_SYNCHRONIZED=YES
BLOCKER=NONE
